home.heroSummary: Built with @deneb-ui/ui. Hot-reload locally, simulate merchant visual editing in the Lab, validate preflight contracts, and package with 1-click.
home.introTitle: Engineered for high conversion and effortless editing
home.introBody: Every editable value comes directly from Fivora site data with auto-balancing layouts, responsive typography, and strict contract validation out of the box.
home.featuresHeading: Why build with the Fivora Authoring Kit?

features.title: Auto-Balancing Layouts
features.body: Cards, grids, and containers automatically balance and fill space seamlessly across all screen sizes.

features.title: Strict Visual Editing
features.body: Direct bindings enable merchants to click, edit, and preview changes without breaking template styles.

features.title: 1-Click Clean Packaging
features.body: Built-in zip command strips heavy caches, node_modules, and git files so uploads pass instantly.

home.productsSummary: Live inventory and pricing updated in real time from your Fivora Shop Owner panel.

about.heading: Built for the next generation of online storefronts
about.body: The Fivora connects businesses with high-converting, beautifully crafted templates. This starter template demonstrates clean monorepo architecture, responsive typography, and auto-balancing components.
about.collageDescription: A quick visual tour of how we design, build, and ship merchant-ready storefronts.
about.history: We began as a small team helping local businesses move online. Today our templates power visual editing labs, strict Fivora contracts, and one-click packaging for developers worldwide.
